findings.evidence: grep over `code/` shows every occurrence of `collarAmbientEquiv` is in `TauCeti/Geometry/Manifold/Boundary/Collar.lean`; the pre-PR idiom for exactly this helper was `private` (`Charts.lean` before the diff: `private noncomputable def boundaryValComplementEquiv`). Collar.lean:21-22 states the characteristic lemmas exist "so later collar constructions do not need to unfold the coordinate implementation".
findings.fix: Mark `collarAmbientEquiv`, its two `apply` lemmas, and `collarHomeomorph_apply_coe` `private` and drop `collarAmbientEquiv` from the "Main definitions" list; the public interface is then `collarHomeomorph`/`collarDiffeomorph` plus their coordinate lemmas, which determine the maps via `EuclideanHalfSpace.ext` and `Fin.cases`. If it must stay public, add `collarAmbientEquiv_symm_apply_fst`/`_symm_apply_snd_apply_zero` and use them in those two proofs.
findings.issue: `collarAmbientEquiv` (with `collarAmbientEquiv_apply_zero`, `collarAmbientEquiv_apply_succ`, and `collarHomeomorph_apply_coe`) is public and listed in "Main definitions", but it has no consumer outside this file and is just `euclideanHalfSpaceBoundaryNormalEquiv` precomposed with `EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1) ≃L ℝ`. It is the coordinate implementation that the file docstring promises consumers need not see, and its exposed API is asymmetric: it has forward coordinate lemmas but no `_symm_apply_fst`/`_symm_apply_snd`, so `collarHomeomorph_symm_apply_fst` (line 134) and `collarHomeomorph_symm_apply_snd_apply_zero` (line 141) discharge their goals by definitional unfolding to `euclideanHalfSpaceBoundaryNormalEquiv_symm_*` instead of a lemma about the exposed name.

findings.evidence: Collar.lean:147-158 proves the zero slice by `Fin.cases` plus `boundaryParam_coe`, `euclideanHalfSpaceBoundaryParam_apply_zero`, a `rfl` for `(0 : EuclideanHalfSpace 1).1`, and `PiLp.zero_apply` — i.e. by unfolding coordinates, precisely because the Model-level interaction lemma is absent.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp] theorem euclideanHalfSpaceBoundaryNormalEquiv_apply_zero_normal (x) : euclideanHalfSpaceBoundaryNormalEquiv n (x, 0) = euclideanHalfSpaceBoundaryParam n x` (provable by `ext i; refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j ↦ ?_) i <;> simp`) and use it in `collarHomeomorph_apply_zero_normal`.
findings.issue: The newly public `euclideanHalfSpaceBoundaryNormalEquiv` is characterized against `euclideanHalfSpaceBoundaryProj` on the `symm` side (lines 195, 212) but has no interaction lemma with the other operation in scope, `euclideanHalfSpaceBoundaryParam`: nothing states that the zero-normal slice is the boundary parametrization.

summary: The collar homeomorphism/diffeomorphism API is complete and correctly annotated, but the ambient coordinate splitting `collarAmbientEquiv` is exposed although it is used only inside `Collar.lean` and carries only half the characteristic lemmas its sibling has. The new public `euclideanHalfSpaceBoundaryNormalEquiv` also lacks its interaction lemma with `euclideanHalfSpaceBoundaryParam`, forcing the collar file to unfold coordinates.
